title: Long-term Follow-up study for relapsed/refractory (R/R) T-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma (T-ALL/LL) patients previously treated with OC-1 cells.
official: Long-term Follow-up study for relapsed/refractory (R/R) T-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma (T-ALL/LL) patients previously treated with OC-1 cells.
summary: Main objective: To monitor patients with primary relapsed/refractory (R/R) CD1a-positive T-ALL/LL who received OC-1 cells, for 15 years following CAR-T infusion to assess the risk of delayed adverse events (AEs).
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Patients previously treated with at least one fraction of OC-1 cell  investigational product
2. Patient or patient’s legal representative has provided signed and  dated informed consent.
3. Patient is able to comply with the study requirements.
Exclusion criteria:
1. None. All patients who have received prior treatment with OC-1 cell  investigational product are eligible for this long-term follow up (LTFU)  study.
